versions.changelog:
hf-daily-deep-researcher v4.2.0 — Major multi-agent architecture & UX upgrade  

- Renamed skill from "hf-daily-researcher-v2" to "hf-daily-deep-researcher"
- Two research modes: light scan (weekly/monthly) and deep research (comprehensive, in-depth)
- Orchestrator auto-selects mode based on user input/time span
- Main Agent directly performs search to ensure full results (avoids sub-agent output truncation)
- Sub-agents (Deep Reader, Analyst, Writer, Checker) handle complex reading, analysis, report writing, and quality checks
- Improved process for completeness detection, robust fallback analysis, and dynamic keyword/config management
